source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִי֙ מֵעִ֣יר עַל־בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י לֵ֣ב קָמָ֑י ר֖וּחַ מַשְׁחִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: Here I [am] stirring up against Babylon and against [the] inhabitants of Leb-qamai a wind of a destroyer.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q Look, I am stirring up against Babylon \q and against the inhabitants of Leb-qamai \q a destroying wind.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q I am stirring up against Babylon \q and against the people who live in Leb-qamai \q a wind that destroys.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q I am about to send a destroying wind \q against Babylon and against the people of Leb-qamai, that is, the Babylonians.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q He aquí, yo levanto contra Babilonia \q y contra los habitantes de Leb-camai \q un viento destructor.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Voy a levantar contra Babilonia \q y contra los que viven en Leb-camai \q un viento que destruye.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Voy a enviar un viento destructor \q contra Babilonia y contra la gente de Leb-camai, es decir, los babilonios.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Voici, je réveille contre Babylone \q et contre les habitants de Leb-Qamaï \q un vent destructeur.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Je réveille contre Babylone \q et contre ceux qui habitent Leb-Qamaï \q un vent qui détruit.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Je vais envoyer un vent destructeur \q contre Babylone et contre les gens de Leb-Qamaï, c’est-à-dire les Babyloniens.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Tazama, ninaamsha juu ya Babeli \q na juu ya wakaaji wa Leb-kamai \q upepo wa mharibu.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Ninaamsha dhidi ya Babeli \q na dhidi ya watu wanaoishi Leb-kamai \q upepo unaoharibu.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Ninakaribia kutuma upepo unaoharibu \q dhidi ya Babeli na dhidi ya watu wa Leb-kamai, yaani Wababeli.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ khơi dậy nghịch cùng Ba-by-lôn \q và nghịch cùng dân cư Lép-ca-mai \q một ngọn gió hủy diệt.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ khơi dậy nghịch cùng Ba-by-lôn \q và nghịch cùng những kẻ sống tại Lép-ca-mai \q một ngọn gió hủy diệt.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp sai một ngọn gió hủy diệt \q đến đánh Ba-by-lôn và dân Lép-ca-mai, tức là người Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 보라, 내가 바빌론과 \q 립가매 주민들을 치려고 \q 멸망시키는 바람을 일으키겠다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 내가 바빌론과 \q 립가매에 사는 사람들을 치려고 \q 파멸의 바람을 일으키겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 나는 멸망시키는 바람을 보내겠다. \q 바빌론과 립가매 사람들, 곧 바빌로니아 사람들을 치게 하겠다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Eis que desperto contra a Babilônia \q e contra os moradores de Lebe-Camai \q um vento destruidor.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Vou despertar contra a Babilônia \q e contra os que moram em Lebe-Camai \q um vento que destrói.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q Vou mandar um vento destruidor \q contra a Babilônia e contra o povo de Lebe-Camai, isto é, os babilônios.

decisions.choice: Leb-qamai: a coded name for the Chaldeans
alternatives: the heart of those who rise up against me
decisions.reason: Leb-qamai is "Chaldeans" written in a simple code called *atbash*, in which the first letter of the alphabet stands for the last, the second for the next to last, and so on. By that code the consonants of *Kasdim*, "Chaldeans", become those of Leb-qamai. The code itself makes words that mean "the heart of those who rise up against me", which fits a people who set themselves against God. The same code turns Babel into Sheshach (25:26; 51:41). Since Babylon is named openly in the same line, the code was probably not for secrecy; it may be a play on words or a mark of contempt. The Greek translation reads "the Chaldeans" here (this is from general knowledge).

decisions.choice: a destroying wind: a wind that destroys, sent by the LORD
decisions.reason: The word can mean wind or spirit, and the phrase could be read "the spirit of a destroyer", that is, God moving the mind of a conqueror, as in verse 11, where the LORD stirs up the spirit of the kings of the Medes. Here the winnowing of verse 2 favors a wind, the hot wind that blows away chaff (4:11-12; 13:24). Both readings say the same thing: the LORD himself sets Babylon's destruction in motion.

decisions.choice: look, I am stirring up: something the LORD is about to do
decisions.reason: The pointing word and the participle announce an act that is already beginning. The same verb returns in verse 11 for the kings of the Medes. The chapter continues the oracle against Babylon begun in 50:1.

decisions.choice: that is, the Babylonians
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the coded name and adds what it stands for, as in 25:26, since most readers would not recognize the code (m1). It says "Babylonians" for the Chaldeans, as Readable does throughout. Literal and Balanced keep the name alone, with the footnote.

decisions.choice: Leb-camai
decisions.reason: A coded name ("heart of my adversaries") that stands for Chaldea (*Kasdim*) by swapping letters of the alphabet; Readable says who is meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Leb-kamai" kept as a name; Readable adds "yaani Wababeli"
decisions.reason: As the English: the name is a coded form of "Chaldeans", which the meaning decision explains; Readable says plainly who is meant.

decisions.choice: Lép-ca-mai
decisions.reason: The Hebrew writes a code name for Chaldea here; Vietnamese keeps it as a name at every level, and Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "립가매", with "곧 바빌로니아 사람들" added at R
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: a coded name for the Chaldeans; Korean keeps the name and Readable explains it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Lebe-Camai
decisions.reason: The coded name (m1) is spelled as Portuguese writes its sounds, joined by a hyphen like other compound names; Readable says who is meant, as the English does.

source.text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֤ל׀זָרִים֙ וְזֵר֔וּהָ וִיבֹקְק֖וּ אֶת־אַרְצָ֑הּ כִּֽי־הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֛יהָ מִסָּבִ֖יב בְּי֥וֹם רָעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will send to Babylon strangers and they will winnow her, and they will empty her land, for they will be against her from around on [the] day of disaster.

en.L: And I will send strangers to Babylon, and they will winnow her, \q and they will empty her land, \q for they will be against her from every side on the day of disaster.
en.B: I will send foreigners to Babylon to winnow her \q and to strip her land bare, \q for they will come against her from every side on the day of disaster.
en.R: I will send foreigners to Babylon. \q They will blow her away like chaff and leave her land empty. \q They will attack her from every side on the day of disaster.

es.L: Y enviaré a Babilonia extranjeros que la aventarán \q y vaciarán su tierra, \q porque estarán contra ella por todos lados en el día de la calamidad.
es.B: Enviaré extranjeros a Babilonia para que la aventen \q y dejen su tierra vacía, \q porque vendrán contra ella por todos lados en el día de la calamidad.
es.R: Enviaré extranjeros a Babilonia. \q Se la llevarán como el viento se lleva la paja, y dejarán vacía su tierra. \q La atacarán por todos lados en el día de la desgracia.

fr.L: Et j’enverrai à Babylone des étrangers, et ils la vanneront, \q et ils videront son pays, \q car ils seront contre elle de tous côtés au jour du malheur.
fr.B: J’enverrai à Babylone des étrangers pour la vanner \q et pour dépouiller son pays, \q car ils viendront contre elle de tous côtés au jour du malheur.
fr.R: J’enverrai des étrangers à Babylone. \q Ils la disperseront comme de la paille au vent et laisseront son pays vide. \q Ils l’attaqueront de tous côtés au jour du malheur.

sw.L: Nami nitatuma wageni Babeli, nao watampepeta, \q nao wataifanya nchi yake tupu, \q kwa maana watakuwa juu yake pande zote katika siku ya msiba.
sw.B: Nitawatuma wageni Babeli wampepete \q na kuifanya nchi yake tupu kabisa, \q kwa maana watamjia kutoka kila upande katika siku ya maafa.
sw.R: Nitawatuma wageni Babeli. \q Watampeperusha kama makapi na kuiacha nchi yake tupu. \q Watamshambulia kutoka kila upande katika siku ya maafa.

vi.L: Ta sẽ sai những kẻ lạ đến Ba-by-lôn, chúng sẽ sàng sảy nó, \q và chúng sẽ làm cho xứ nó trống không, \q vì chúng sẽ đến đánh nó từ mọi phía trong ngày tai họa.
vi.B: Ta sẽ sai những kẻ ngoại bang đến Ba-by-lôn để sàng sảy nó \q và làm cho xứ nó trống trơn, \q vì chúng sẽ đến đánh nó từ mọi phía trong ngày tai họa.
vi.R: Ta sẽ sai những người ngoại quốc đến Ba-by-lôn. \q Chúng sẽ thổi bay nó như trấu và để lại xứ nó trống không. \q Chúng sẽ tấn công nó từ mọi phía trong ngày tai họa.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 바빌론에 타국인들을 보내리니, 그들이 그를 키질하고, \q 그의 땅을 텅 비게 할 것이다. \q 재앙의 날에 그들이 사방에서 그를 칠 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 내가 바빌론에 이방 사람들을 보내어 그를 키질하게 하고, \q 그의 땅을 텅 비게 하겠다. \q 재앙의 날에 그들이 사방에서 그를 칠 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 외국 사람들을 바빌론에 보내겠다. \q 그들은 바빌론을 겨처럼 날려 버리고, 그 땅을 텅 비게 할 것이다. \q 재앙의 날에 그들은 사방에서 바빌론을 공격할 것이다.

pt.L: E enviarei estrangeiros à Babilônia, e eles a joeirarão, \q e esvaziarão a sua terra, \q pois estarão contra ela de todos os lados no dia da desgraça.
pt.B: Enviarei estrangeiros à Babilônia para joeirá-la \q e deixar a sua terra vazia, \q pois virão contra ela de todos os lados no dia da desgraça.
pt.R: Vou mandar estrangeiros à Babilônia. \q Eles vão espalhá-la como palha ao vento e deixar a sua terra vazia. \q Vão atacá-la de todos os lados no dia da desgraça.

decisions.choice: strangers ... winnow: a play on two words that sound alike
decisions.reason: The word for "strangers" (*zarim*) and the verb "winnow" (*zarah*) sound alike, so the foreigners who come against Babylon are pictured as winnowers. Winnowing tossed threshed grain into the wind, which carried the chaff away (15:7; Isaiah 41:16). The same letters could also be read "winnowers", which the play invites; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: empty her land: strip it of people and goods
decisions.reason: The verb means to empty out or lay waste, as a jar is emptied (19:7; Isaiah 24:1). The land will be left bare like a threshing floor after the wind has done its work.

decisions.choice: foreigners; blow her away like chaff
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "foreigners", the plain sense of the word. Readable explains winnowing as blowing chaff away, so that the picture is clear.

source.text: אֶֽל־יִדְרֹ֤ךְ הַדֹּרֵךְ֙ קַשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְאֶל־יִתְעַ֖ל בְּסִרְיֹנ֑וֹ וְאַֽל־תַּחְמְלוּ֙ אֶל־בַּ֣חֻרֶ֔יהָ הַחֲרִ֖ימוּ כָּל־צְבָאָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Against [him who] bends let bend the [one] bending his bow, and against [him who] lifts himself in his armor; and do not spare her young men; devote to destruction all her army.

en.L: Against the one who bends [his bow] let the archer bend his bow, \q and against the one who rises up in his armor; \q do not spare her young men; \q devote all her army to destruction.
en.B: Let the archer bend his bow against her archer, \q against the one who stands up in his armor. \q Do not spare her young men; \q destroy her whole army completely.
en.R: Let the archers shoot at her archers \q and at her soldiers wearing armor. \q Do not spare her young men. \q Destroy her whole army, as given over to the LORD.

es.L: Contra el que tensa [su arco] tense el arquero su arco, \q y contra el que se yergue con su coraza; \q no {{plural_you:perdonen|perdonéis}} a sus jóvenes; \q {{plural_you:destruyan|destruid}} por completo a todo su ejército.
es.B: Que el arquero tense su arco contra el arquero de ella, \q contra el que se levanta con su coraza. \q No {{plural_you:perdonen|perdonéis}} a sus jóvenes; \q {{plural_you:destruyan|destruid}} por completo a todo su ejército.
es.R: Que los arqueros disparen contra sus arqueros \q y contra sus soldados con armadura. \q No {{plural_you:perdonen|perdonéis}} a sus jóvenes. \q {{plural_you:Destruyan|Destruid}} a todo su ejército, como cosa entregada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Contre celui qui tend [son arc], que l’archer tende son arc, \q et contre celui qui se dresse dans sa cuirasse ; \q n’épargnez pas ses jeunes gens ; \q vouez à l’interdit toute son armée.
fr.B: Que l’archer tende son arc contre son archer, \q contre celui qui se dresse dans sa cuirasse. \q N’épargnez pas ses jeunes gens ; \q vouez à l’interdit toute son armée.
fr.R: Que les archers tirent sur ses archers \q et sur ses soldats en armure. \q N’épargnez pas ses jeunes gens. \q Détruisez toute son armée, comme ce qui est voué à Dieu.

sw.L: Juu ya yeye apindaye [upinde wake] mpiga upinde na aupinde upinde wake, \q na juu ya yeye ajiinuaye katika dirii yake; \q msiwahurumie vijana wake; \q liangamizeni kabisa jeshi lake lote.
sw.B: Mpiga upinde na aupinde upinde wake dhidi ya mpiga upinde wake, \q dhidi ya yule anayesimama katika dirii yake. \q Msiwahurumie vijana wake; \q liangamizeni kabisa jeshi lake lote.
sw.R: Wapiga mishale na wawapige wapiga mishale wake \q na askari wake waliovaa mavazi ya vita. \q Msiwahurumie vijana wake. \q Liangamizeni jeshi lake lote, kama vitu vilivyotolewa kwa Mungu.

vi.L: Kẻ giương [cung] hãy giương cung nghịch cùng kẻ giương cung, \q và nghịch cùng kẻ mặc áo giáp đứng dậy; \q đừng tha các thanh niên của nó; \q hãy tận diệt cả đạo quân của nó.
vi.B: Hãy để cung thủ giương cung bắn vào cung thủ của nó, \q bắn vào kẻ mặc áo giáp đứng dậy. \q Đừng tha các thanh niên của nó; \q hãy tận diệt cả đạo quân của nó.
vi.R: Hãy để các cung thủ bắn vào các cung thủ của nó \q và bắn vào quân lính mặc áo giáp của nó. \q Đừng tha các thanh niên của nó. \q Hãy tiêu diệt cả đạo quân của nó, như vật đã dâng hiến cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 활을 당기는 자를 향하여 활 쏘는 자가 그의 활을 당기게 하고, \q 갑옷을 입고 일어서는 자를 향하여 [그렇게 하여라]. \q 그의 젊은이들을 아끼지 말고, \q 그의 온 군대를 진멸하여 바쳐라.
ko.B: 활 쏘는 자가 그의 활 쏘는 자를 향하여 활을 당기게 하고, \q 갑옷을 입고 일어서는 자를 향하여 쏘게 하여라. \q 그의 젊은이들을 아끼지 말고, \q 그의 온 군대를 진멸하여 바쳐라.
ko.R: 활 쏘는 군인들이 바빌론의 활 쏘는 군인들을 쏘게 하여라. \q 갑옷을 입은 군인들을 쏘게 하여라. \q 그의 젊은이들을 살려 두지 마라. \q 그의 온 군대를 완전히 멸망시켜 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바쳐라.

pt.L: Contra o que retesa [o seu arco] retese o arqueiro o seu arco, \q e contra o que se levanta na sua couraça; \q não poupem os seus jovens; \q destinem à destruição todo o seu exército.
pt.B: Que o arqueiro retese o arco contra o arqueiro dela, \q contra o que se levanta com a sua couraça. \q Não poupem os seus jovens; \q destruam completamente todo o seu exército.
pt.R: Que os arqueiros atirem nos arqueiros dela \q e nos seus soldados que usam armadura. \q Não poupem os seus jovens. \q Destruam todo o seu exército, como entregue {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

decisions.choice: against the one who bends: the attackers are to shoot down Babylon's archers and armored men
alternatives: Let not the archer bend his bow, nor rise up in his armor
decisions.reason: The Hebrew as pointed says "against" twice. Read that way, the line commands the attackers to aim their bows at Babylon's defenders. With a change of one vowel the same letters mean "let not", and the line would say "Let not the archer bend his bow, let him not rise up in his armor", that is, Babylon's soldiers will not even get to fight. The second half of the verse speaks to the attackers, which suits the first reading. The written text also repeats the verb "bend"; the reading tradition reads it once.

decisions.choice: devote to destruction: give over wholly to God by destroying it
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for *cherem*, the destruction of an enemy as something devoted to God (Deuteronomy 7:2; Joshua 6:21). Babylon's army is to be destroyed without survivors (50:21, 26).

decisions.choice: [his bow]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the object the first verb leaves out. Balanced and Readable say "her archer" and "her soldiers" to show whom the attackers aim at (m1).

decisions.choice: Destroy ... completely, as given over to the LORD
decisions.reason: As in Numbers to Ruth, Readable explains the verb of *cherem* rather than using "devote".

source.text: וְנָפְל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וּמְדֻקָּרִ֖ים בְּחוּצוֹתֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will fall slain in [the] land of [the] Chaldeans and pierced in her streets.

en.L: And they will fall slain in the land of the Chaldeans, \q and pierced through in her streets.
en.B: They will fall dead in the land of the Chaldeans, \q run through in her streets.
en.R: Her people will fall dead in the land of Babylonia. \q They will be stabbed to death in her streets.

es.L: Y caerán muertos en la tierra de los caldeos, \q y traspasados en sus calles.
es.B: Caerán muertos en la tierra de los caldeos, \q atravesados en sus calles.
es.R: Su gente caerá muerta en la tierra de Babilonia. \q Los matarán a puñaladas en sus calles.

fr.L: Et ils tomberont blessés à mort au pays des Chaldéens, \q et transpercés dans ses rues.
fr.B: Ils tomberont morts au pays des Chaldéens, \q transpercés dans ses rues.
fr.R: Ses habitants tomberont morts dans le pays de Babylonie. \q On les tuera à coups d’épée dans ses rues.

sw.L: Nao wataanguka wameuawa katika nchi ya Wakaldayo, \q na kuchomwa katika mitaa yake.
sw.B: Wataanguka wakiwa wamekufa katika nchi ya Wakaldayo, \q wamechomwa kwa mikuki katika mitaa yake.
sw.R: Watu wake wataanguka wakiwa wamekufa katika nchi ya Babeli. \q Watachomwa mpaka kufa katika mitaa yake.

vi.L: Chúng sẽ ngã chết trong xứ của người Canh-đê, \q và bị đâm thủng trên các đường phố nó.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ ngã chết trong xứ của người Canh-đê, \q bị đâm thủng trên các đường phố nó.
vi.R: Dân nó sẽ ngã chết trong xứ Ba-by-lôn. \q Họ sẽ bị đâm chết trên các đường phố của nó.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 갈대아 사람들의 땅에서 죽임을 당하여 쓰러지고, \q 그의 거리들에서 찔려 [쓰러질 것이다].
ko.B: 그들이 갈대아 사람들의 땅에서 죽어 쓰러지고, \q 그의 거리들에서 칼에 찔려 쓰러질 것이다.
ko.R: 바빌론 백성은 바빌로니아 땅에서 죽어 쓰러질 것이다. \q 그들은 거리에서 칼에 찔려 죽을 것이다.

pt.L: E cairão mortos na terra dos caldeus, \q e traspassados nas suas ruas.
pt.B: Cairão mortos na terra dos caldeus, \q atravessados nas suas ruas.
pt.R: O seu povo vai cair morto na terra da Babilônia. \q Vão ser mortos a golpes de espada nas suas ruas.

decisions.choice: slain ... pierced through: killed by weapons
decisions.reason: The first word names those killed in battle; the second, those stabbed through with a sword or spear (37:10; Isaiah 13:15). The killing reaches into the city's own streets.

decisions.choice: Babylonia; Her people
decisions.reason: Readable says "Babylonia" for the land of the Chaldeans and names who falls, which the Hebrew leaves to the context.

source.text: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־אַלְמָ֨ן יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וִֽיהוּדָה֙ מֵֽאֱלֹהָ֔יו מֵֽיְהוָ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת כִּ֤י אַרְצָם֙ מָלְאָ֣ה אָשָׁ֔ם מִקְּד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: For not widowed [is] Israel and Judah from his God, from Yahweh of hosts, for their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.

en.L: For Israel and Judah are not widowed of their God, \q of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, \q though their land is full of guilt \q against the Holy One of Israel.
en.B: For Israel and Judah have not been left widowed by their God, \q by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q though their land is filled with guilt \q against the Holy One of Israel.
en.R: Israel and Judah are not like widows whose husband is gone. \q Their God, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, has not left them, \q even though their land is filled with sin \q against the Holy One of Israel.

es.L: Porque Israel y Judá no han quedado viudos de su Dios, \q {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, \q aunque su tierra está llena de culpa \q contra el Santo de Israel.
es.B: Porque Israel y Judá no han quedado viudos, abandonados por su Dios, \q por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q aunque su tierra está llena de culpa \q contra el Santo de Israel.
es.R: Israel y Judá no son como viudas que han perdido a su marido. \q Su Dios, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, no los ha abandonado, \q aunque su tierra está llena de pecado \q contra el Santo de Israel.

fr.L: Car Israël et Juda ne sont pas veufs de leur Dieu, \q {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, \q bien que leur pays soit plein de culpabilité \q envers le Saint d’Israël.
fr.B: Car Israël et Juda n’ont pas été laissés veufs par leur Dieu, \q par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q même si leur pays est rempli de fautes \q contre le Saint d’Israël.
fr.R: Israël et Juda ne sont pas comme des veuves qui ont perdu leur mari. \q Leur Dieu, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, ne les a pas abandonnés, \q même si leur pays est plein de péchés \q contre le Saint d’Israël.

sw.L: Kwa maana Israeli na Yuda hawakuachwa wajane na Mungu wao, \q na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q ingawa nchi yao imejaa hatia \q juu ya Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Kwa maana Israeli na Yuda hawajaachwa kama wajane na Mungu wao, \q na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q ingawa nchi yao imejaa hatia \q dhidi ya Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Israeli na Yuda si kama wajane ambao waume zao wamekufa. \q Mungu wao, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, hajawaacha, \q ingawa nchi yao imejaa dhambi \q dhidi ya Mtakatifu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Vì Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa không bị Đức Chúa Trời mình, \q là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, bỏ cho góa bụa, \q dù đất của chúng đầy tội lỗi \q nghịch cùng Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vì Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa không bị Đức Chúa Trời mình, \q là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, bỏ rơi như góa phụ, \q dù đất của họ đầy tội lỗi \q nghịch cùng Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa không giống như những người góa bụa mất chồng. \q Đức Chúa Trời của họ, là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, đã không bỏ họ, \q dù đất của họ đầy tội lỗi \q nghịch cùng Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 이스라엘과 유다는 그들의 하나님, \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 버림받아 과부가 되지 않았다. \q 그들의 땅이 \q 이스라엘의 거룩하신 분께 지은 죄로 가득할지라도 그러하다.
ko.B: 이스라엘과 유다는 그들의 하나님, \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 버림받은 과부가 아니다. \q 그들의 땅이 \q 이스라엘의 거룩하신 분께 지은 죄로 가득할지라도 그러하다.
ko.R: 이스라엘과 유다는 남편을 잃은 과부와 같지 않다. \q 그들의 하나님, 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 버리지 않으셨다. \q 그들의 땅이 \q 이스라엘의 거룩하신 분께 지은 죄로 가득할지라도 그러하다.

pt.L: Pois Israel e Judá não ficaram viúvos do seu Deus, \q {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q ainda que a terra deles esteja cheia de culpa \q contra o Santo de Israel.
pt.B: Pois Israel e Judá não foram deixados viúvos pelo seu Deus, \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q ainda que a terra deles esteja cheia de culpa \q contra o Santo de Israel.
pt.R: Israel e Judá não são como viúvas que perderam o marido. \q O seu Deus, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, não os abandonou, \q mesmo que a terra deles esteja cheia de pecado \q contra o Santo de Israel.

decisions.choice: widowed: left without a husband to protect them
decisions.reason: Israel is pictured as a wife and the LORD as her husband (3:14; 31:32; Isaiah 54:4-6). Though she is in exile, he has not died or left her; he will act for her against Babylon.

decisions.choice: though their land is full of guilt: most likely Israel's land, in spite of its sin
alternatives: for the land of the Chaldeans is full of guilt
decisions.reason: The small word can mean "for" or "though", and "their land" can mean the land of Israel and Judah or the land of the Chaldeans. Read as "though", the line says the LORD keeps faith with his people in spite of their sin. Read as "for", it gives the reason for Babylon's punishment: the Chaldeans' land is full of guilt against the Holy One. The words "their land" most naturally refer back to Israel and Judah, just named.

decisions.choice: the Holy One of Israel
decisions.reason: Isaiah's title for God (Isaiah 1:4), used in Jeremiah only in the oracle against Babylon (50:29; 51:5). Babylon's pride is an offense against Israel's holy God.

decisions.choice: like widows whose husband is gone ... has not left them
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the widow (m1) in two sentences.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah, Balanced and Readable say "Armies" for "hosts".

decisions.choice: "이스라엘의 거룩하신 분"
decisions.reason: Here God is spoken of, not speaking, so the title takes the honorific (terms note).

source.text: נֻ֣סוּ׀מִתּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֗ל וּמַלְּטוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ אַל־תִּדַּ֖מּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָ֑הּ כִּי֩ עֵ֨ת נְקָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה גְּמ֕וּל ה֥וּא מְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Flee from [the] midst of Babylon and save each his life; do not be silenced in her iniquity, for [it is the] time of vengeance for Yahweh; [the] recompense he [is] repaying to her.

en.L: Flee from the midst of Babylon, \q and save your lives, each one; \q do not be destroyed in her iniquity, \q for it is the time of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s vengeance; \q the recompense {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is paying back to her.
en.B: Flee from Babylon! \q Every one of you, run for your life! \q Do not be destroyed when she is punished for her guilt, \q for this is the time of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s vengeance; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is paying her back what she deserves.
en.R: Run away from Babylon! \q Everyone, run for your life! \q Do not die when she is punished for her sins. \q It is time for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to pay her back. \q He will give her what she deserves.

es.L: {{plural_you:Huyan|Huid}} de en medio de Babilonia, \q y {{plural_you:salven|salvad}} cada uno su vida; \q no {{plural_you:perezcan|perezcáis}} por su iniquidad, \q porque es el tiempo de la venganza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le da su pago.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Huyan|Huid}} de Babilonia! \q ¡Que cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} corra para salvar su vida! \q No {{plural_you:mueran|muráis}} cuando ella sea castigada por su culpa, \q porque es el tiempo de la venganza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le da lo que merece.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Huyan|Huid}} de Babilonia! \q ¡Que todos corran para salvar su vida! \q No {{plural_you:mueran|muráis}} cuando ella sea castigada por sus pecados. \q Es el tiempo en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dará su merecido. \q Le dará lo que se merece.

fr.L: Fuyez du milieu de Babylone, \q et sauvez chacun sa vie ; \q ne périssez pas dans son iniquité, \q car c’est le temps de la vengeance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; \q la rétribution, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la lui rend.
fr.B: Fuyez Babylone ! \q Que chacun de vous sauve sa vie ! \q Ne périssez pas quand elle sera punie pour sa faute, \q car c’est le temps de la vengeance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui rend ce qu’elle mérite.
fr.R: Enfuyez-vous de Babylone ! \q Que chacun sauve sa vie ! \q Ne mourez pas quand elle sera punie pour ses péchés. \q Le moment est venu où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va la faire payer. \q Il lui donnera ce qu’elle mérite.

sw.L: Kimbieni kutoka katikati ya Babeli, \q na kila mtu aokoe nafsi yake; \q msiangamizwe katika uovu wake, \q kwa maana ni wakati wa kisasi cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q malipo anamlipa.
sw.B: Kimbieni kutoka Babeli! \q Kila mmoja wenu, okoeni maisha yenu! \q Msiangamizwe atakapoadhibiwa kwa hatia yake, \q kwa maana huu ni wakati wa kisasi cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q anamlipa kile anachostahili.
sw.R: Kimbieni kutoka Babeli! \q Kila mtu, okoa maisha yako! \q Msife atakapoadhibiwa kwa dhambi zake. \q Ni wakati wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kumlipiza. \q Atampa kile anachostahili.

vi.L: Hãy chạy trốn khỏi giữa Ba-by-lôn, \q mỗi người hãy cứu mạng sống mình; \q đừng bị diệt vì tội ác của nó, \q vì đây là thời kỳ báo thù của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} báo trả nó điều nó đáng chịu.
vi.B: Hãy chạy trốn khỏi Ba-by-lôn! \q Mỗi người hãy chạy cho thoát thân! \q Đừng để bị diệt khi nó bị trừng phạt vì tội lỗi nó, \q vì đây là thời kỳ báo thù của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang báo trả nó điều nó đáng chịu.
vi.R: Hãy chạy khỏi Ba-by-lôn! \q Mọi người hãy chạy thoát thân! \q Đừng chết khi nó bị trừng phạt vì tội lỗi mình. \q Đã đến lúc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} báo trả nó. \q Ngài sẽ báo trả nó điều nó đáng chịu.

ko.L: 바빌론 가운데서 도망하여라. \q 각자 자기 목숨을 구하여라. \q 그의 죄악 때문에 멸망하지 마라. \q 지금은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 복수하실 때이니, \q 그분께서 그에게 보응을 갚으신다.
ko.B: 바빌론에서 도망하여라! \q 저마다 목숨을 건져라! \q 바빌론이 죄악 때문에 벌받을 때 함께 멸망하지 마라. \q 지금은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 복수하실 때다. \q 그분께서 바빌론에게 마땅한 대로 갚으신다.
ko.R: 바빌론에서 달아나라! \q 모두 살려고 도망쳐라! \q 바빌론이 죄 때문에 벌받을 때 함께 죽지 마라. \q 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바빌론에게 갚으실 때가 되었다. \q 그분께서 바빌론에게 받아야 할 벌을 주실 것이다.

pt.L: Fujam do meio da Babilônia, \q e salve cada um a sua vida; \q não sejam destruídos na iniquidade dela, \q pois é o tempo da vingança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; \q a paga que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe dá de volta.
pt.B: Fujam da Babilônia! \q Corra cada um de vocês para salvar a vida! \q Não sejam destruídos quando ela for castigada pela sua culpa, \q pois este é o tempo da vingança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai lhe pagar o que ela merece.
pt.R: Fujam da Babilônia! \q Todos, corram para salvar a vida! \q Não morram quando ela for castigada pelos seus pecados. \q É hora de {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fazer a Babilônia pagar. \q Ele vai dar a ela o que ela merece.

decisions.choice: be destroyed: be cut off, perish
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to be silent and so to be destroyed (8:14; 25:37; 47:5). Those who stay in Babylon will be caught up in her end.

decisions.choice: her iniquity: her guilt and the punishment it brings
decisions.reason: The word means wrongdoing and also the penalty that follows it (Genesis 4:13). Those who stay will share Babylon's punishment. The call to flee returns in verse 45 and 50:8.

decisions.choice: recompense: what she has earned
decisions.reason: The word means a deed's full return, good or bad (Isaiah 59:18). Babylon receives what her deeds deserve; verse 56 calls the LORD "a God of recompense".

decisions.choice: when she is punished for her guilt (Balanced); for her sins (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "in her iniquity" means (m2). Iniquity is "guilt" at Balanced and "sin" at Readable, as Isaiah does.

source.text: כּוֹס־זָהָ֤ב בָּבֶל֙ בְּיַד־יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁכֶּ֖רֶת כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מִיֵּינָהּ֙ שָׁת֣וּ גוֹיִ֔ם עַל־כֵּ֖ן יִתְהֹלְל֥וּ גוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: A cup of gold [was] Babylon in [the] hand of Yahweh, making drunk all the earth; from her wine nations drank; therefore nations go mad.

en.L: Babylon [was] a cup of gold in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s hand, \q making all the earth drunk; \q the nations drank of her wine; \q therefore the nations go mad.
en.B: Babylon was a golden cup in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s hand, \q making the whole earth drunk; \q the nations drank her wine, \q and so the nations have gone mad.
en.R: Babylon was like a gold cup that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} held in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. \q She made the whole world drunk. \q The nations drank her wine, \q and so they acted as if they were crazy.

es.L: Copa de oro [era] Babilonia en la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q que embriagaba a toda la tierra; \q de su vino bebieron las naciones; \q por eso enloquecen las naciones.
es.B: Babilonia era una copa de oro en la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q que embriagaba a toda la tierra; \q las naciones bebieron de su vino, \q y por eso han enloquecido.
es.R: Babilonia era como una copa de oro que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tenía en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano. \q Emborrachó a todo el mundo. \q Las naciones bebieron de su vino, \q y por eso actuaban como locas.

fr.L: Babylone [était] une coupe d’or dans la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q qui enivrait toute la terre ; \q les nations ont bu de son vin ; \q c’est pourquoi les nations sont devenues folles.
fr.B: Babylone était une coupe d’or dans la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q qui enivrait toute la terre ; \q les nations ont bu son vin, \q et c’est pourquoi les nations ont perdu la raison.
fr.R: Babylone était comme une coupe en or que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tenait dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main. \q Elle a rendu le monde entier ivre. \q Les nations ont bu son vin, \q et elles se sont conduites comme des folles.

sw.L: Babeli [ilikuwa] kikombe cha dhahabu mkononi mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kilicholevya dunia yote; \q mataifa walikunywa divai yake; \q kwa hiyo mataifa wanaenda wazimu.
sw.B: Babeli ilikuwa kikombe cha dhahabu mkononi mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kilicholevya dunia yote; \q mataifa walikunywa divai yake, \q na kwa hiyo mataifa wamerukwa na akili.
sw.R: Babeli ilikuwa kama kikombe cha dhahabu ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikishika mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. \q Iliilevya dunia yote. \q Mataifa walikunywa divai yake, \q na kwa hiyo walitenda kama watu waliorukwa na akili.

vi.L: Ba-by-lôn [đã là] chén vàng trong tay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q làm cho cả đất say sưa; \q các dân tộc đã uống rượu của nó; \q vì vậy các dân tộc trở nên điên cuồng.
vi.B: Ba-by-lôn đã là chén vàng trong tay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q làm cho cả đất say sưa; \q các dân tộc đã uống rượu của nó, \q nên các dân tộc đã trở nên điên dại.
vi.R: Ba-by-lôn từng như một chén vàng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cầm trong tay. \q Nó đã làm cho cả thế giới say. \q Các dân tộc đã uống rượu của nó, \q vì thế họ cư xử như người điên.

ko.L: 바빌론은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 손에 [든] 금잔이었다. \q 온 땅을 취하게 했다. \q 민족들이 그 포도주를 마셨다. \q 그러므로 민족들이 미쳐 버렸다.
ko.B: 바빌론은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 손에 들린 금잔이었다. \q 그 잔이 온 세상을 취하게 했다. \q 민족들이 그 포도주를 마시고, \q 그래서 민족들이 미쳐 버렸다.
ko.R: 바빌론은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 손에 드신 금잔과 같았다. \q 바빌론이 온 세상을 취하게 했다. \q 민족들이 그 포도주를 마셨다. \q 그래서 그들은 미친 사람처럼 행동했다.

pt.L: A Babilônia [era] um cálice de ouro na mão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q que embriagava toda a terra; \q as nações beberam do seu vinho; \q por isso as nações enlouquecem.
pt.B: A Babilônia era um cálice de ouro na mão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q que embriagava a terra inteira; \q as nações beberam do seu vinho, \q e por isso as nações enlouqueceram.
pt.R: A Babilônia era como um cálice de ouro que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} segurava na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão. \q Ela fez o mundo inteiro ficar bêbado. \q As nações beberam do seu vinho, \q e por isso agiram como se estivessem loucas.

decisions.choice: a cup of gold in the LORD's hand: Babylon as the cup of God's wrath
decisions.reason: In 25:15-29 the LORD gives Jeremiah the cup of the wine of his wrath for the nations to drink, and the nations reel and go mad (25:16). Here Babylon herself is that cup: through her conquests God made the nations drink his judgment. The cup is gold because Babylon was rich and splendid. Revelation 17:4 and 18:3 take up the picture.

decisions.choice: go mad: act out of their minds
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 25:16 of the nations who drink the cup: they lose control like drunken people.

decisions.choice: was a cup: Babylon's past role, now ending
decisions.reason: There is no verb. Babylon has been God's cup; now (verse 8) the cup itself falls and breaks.

decisions.choice: like a gold cup that the LORD held
decisions.reason: Readable says "like" to mark the picture as a comparison, and "acted as if they were crazy" for the verb of madness, as in 25:16.

decisions.choice: um cálice de ouro
decisions.reason: The cup of God's wrath (m1) is "cálice", the word 25:15 sets for the book.

source.text: פִּתְאֹ֛ם נָפְלָ֥ה בָבֶ֖ל וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֑ר הֵילִ֣ילוּ עָלֶ֗יהָ קְח֤וּ צֳרִי֙ לְמַכְאוֹבָ֔הּ אוּלַ֖י תֵּרָפֵֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and is broken; wail over her; take balm for her pain; perhaps she will be healed.

en.L: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and is shattered; \q wail over her! Take balm for her pain; \q perhaps she will be healed.
en.B: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and is shattered. \q Wail over her! Bring balm for her wound; \q perhaps she can be healed.
en.R: All of a sudden Babylon has fallen and is broken to pieces. \q Cry out in grief for her! Bring healing balm for her wound. \q Maybe she can be healed.

es.L: De repente cayó Babilonia, y se hizo pedazos; \q ¡{{plural_you:giman|gemid}} por ella! {{plural_you:Tomen|Tomad}} bálsamo para su dolor; \q quizá sane.
es.B: De repente Babilonia ha caído y se ha hecho pedazos. \q ¡{{plural_you:Giman|Gemid}} por ella! {{plural_you:Traigan|Traed}} bálsamo para su herida; \q tal vez pueda sanar.
es.R: De repente Babilonia ha caído y se ha hecho pedazos. \q ¡{{plural_you:Lloren|Llorad}} de dolor por ella! {{plural_you:Traigan|Traed}} bálsamo que cure su herida. \q Tal vez pueda sanar.

fr.L: Soudain Babylone est tombée et elle est brisée ; \q lamentez-vous sur elle ! Prenez du baume pour sa douleur ; \q peut-être sera-t-elle guérie.
fr.B: Soudain Babylone est tombée, elle est brisée. \q Lamentez-vous sur elle ! Apportez du baume pour sa blessure ; \q peut-être pourra-t-elle guérir.
fr.R: Tout à coup, Babylone est tombée et elle est brisée en morceaux. \q Pleurez sur elle ! Apportez du baume pour soigner sa blessure. \q Peut-être qu’elle pourra guérir.

sw.L: Ghafula Babeli imeanguka na kuvunjika; \q mpigieni yowe! Chukueni zeri kwa ajili ya maumivu yake; \q huenda ataponywa.
sw.B: Ghafula Babeli imeanguka na kuvunjwavunjwa. \q Mpigieni yowe! Leteni zeri kwa ajili ya jeraha lake; \q huenda anaweza kuponywa.
sw.R: Ghafula Babeli imeanguka na kuvunjika vipande vipande. \q Mlilieni kwa huzuni! Leteni zeri ya kuponya kwa ajili ya jeraha lake. \q Labda anaweza kuponywa.

vi.L: Thình lình Ba-by-lôn đã sụp đổ và bị đập tan; \q hãy than khóc nó! Hãy lấy nhũ hương cho vết thương nó; \q có lẽ nó sẽ được lành.
vi.B: Thình lình Ba-by-lôn đã sụp đổ và tan nát. \q Hãy than khóc nó! Hãy đem nhũ hương đến chữa vết thương nó; \q có lẽ nó sẽ được chữa lành.
vi.R: Bỗng chốc Ba-by-lôn đã sụp đổ và vỡ tan tành. \q Hãy khóc thương nó! Hãy đem nhũ hương đến chữa vết thương nó. \q Có thể nó sẽ được lành.

ko.L: 갑자기 바빌론이 쓰러져 부서졌다. \q 그를 위하여 울부짖어라! 그의 고통에 유향을 가져오너라. \q 혹시 그가 나을지도 모른다.
ko.B: 바빌론이 갑자기 쓰러져 산산이 부서졌다. \q 그를 위하여 울부짖어라! 그의 상처에 유향을 가져오너라. \q 혹시 나을 수 있을지도 모른다.
ko.R: 바빌론이 갑자기 쓰러져 산산조각이 났다. \q 바빌론을 위하여 슬피 울어라! 상처에 바를 유향을 가져오너라. \q 어쩌면 나을 수도 있을 것이다.

pt.L: De repente a Babilônia caiu e está despedaçada; \q uivem por ela! Tomem bálsamo para a sua dor; \q talvez seja curada.
pt.B: De repente a Babilônia caiu e está despedaçada. \q Lamentem por ela! Tragam bálsamo para a sua ferida; \q talvez ela possa ser curada.
pt.R: De uma hora para outra a Babilônia caiu e ficou em pedaços. \q Chorem de tristeza por ela! Tragam bálsamo para curar a sua ferida. \q Talvez ela possa ser curada.

decisions.choice: has fallen: what is certain to happen told as if already done
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the past tense, a way prophets announce a coming event as certain. The fall is sudden, like the fall of a cup from the hand (verse 7).

decisions.choice: take balm ... perhaps she will be healed: a mocking echo of 8:22 and 46:11
decisions.reason: Gilead's balm was a well-known medicine (8:22). In 46:11 Egypt is told to go up to Gilead for balm, in vain. Here those who see Babylon fall are told to try balm on her; the "perhaps" is ironic, and verse 9 says no cure works.

decisions.choice: her pain: her wound
decisions.reason: The word means pain, and here the wound that causes it (15:18; 30:15).

decisions.choice: Cry out in grief
decisions.reason: Readable says "Cry out in grief" for "Wail", the wording set in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "유향" for the balm, as at 46:11
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: a mocking echo of 8:22 and 46:11.

decisions.choice: bálsamo
decisions.reason: The mocking echo of 8:22 and 46:11 (m2) keeps their word "bálsamo".

source.text: רִפִּ֣ינוּ אֶת־בָּבֶל֙ וְלֹ֣א נִרְפָּ֔תָה עִזְב֕וּהָ וְנֵלֵ֖ךְ אִ֣ישׁ לְאַרְצ֑וֹ כִּֽי־נָגַ֤ע אֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִשְׁפָּטָ֔הּ וְנִשָּׂ֖א עַד־שְׁחָקִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: We healed Babylon, and she was not healed; leave her, and let us go each to his land, for has reached to the heavens her judgment, and it is lifted up to [the] skies.

en.L: "We would have healed Babylon, but she was not healed. \q Leave her, and let us go, each to {{gender:their|his}} own land, \q for her judgment has reached to the heavens \q and is lifted up to the skies."
en.B: "We tried to heal Babylon, but she could not be healed. \q Leave her; let us go, each of us to our own land, \q for her judgment reaches up to the heavens; \q it rises as high as the clouds."
en.R: "We tried to make Babylon well, but she could not be healed. \q Let us leave her and go home, every one of us to our own country. \q Her punishment is as big as the sky. \q It reaches all the way to the clouds."

es.L: «Quisimos curar a Babilonia, pero no sanó. \q {{plural_you:Déjenla|Dejadla}}, y vámonos cada uno a su tierra, \q porque su juicio ha llegado hasta los cielos \q y se ha elevado hasta las nubes».
es.B: «Tratamos de curar a Babilonia, pero no pudo sanar. \q {{plural_you:Déjenla|Dejadla}}; vámonos cada uno a nuestra tierra, \q porque su juicio llega hasta los cielos; \q se eleva hasta las nubes».
es.R: «Tratamos de curar a Babilonia, pero no pudo sanar. \q Dejémosla y volvamos a casa, cada uno a su país. \q Su castigo es tan grande como el cielo. \q Llega hasta las nubes».

fr.L: « Nous avons voulu soigner Babylone, mais elle n’a pas guéri. \q Laissez-la, et allons-nous-en chacun dans son pays, \q car son jugement a atteint les cieux \q et s’est élevé jusqu’aux nues. »
fr.B: « Nous avons essayé de soigner Babylone, mais elle n’a pas pu guérir. \q Laissez-la ; partons, chacun vers son pays, \q car son jugement monte jusqu’au ciel ; \q il s’élève jusqu’aux nuages. »
fr.R: « Nous avons essayé de guérir Babylone, mais elle n’a pas pu guérir. \q Laissons-la et rentrons chez nous, chacun dans son pays. \q Sa punition est aussi grande que le ciel. \q Elle monte jusqu’aux nuages. »

sw.L: "Tungemponya Babeli, lakini hakuponywa. \q Mwacheni, twende zetu, kila mtu nchi yake, \q kwa maana hukumu yake imefika mpaka mbinguni \q na kuinuka hata mawinguni."
sw.B: "Tulijaribu kumponya Babeli, lakini hakuweza kuponywa. \q Mwacheni; twende zetu, kila mmoja nchi yake, \q kwa maana hukumu yake inafika mpaka mbinguni; \q inapanda juu hata mawinguni."
sw.R: "Tulijaribu kumponya Babeli, lakini hakuweza kupona. \q Tumwache, twende nyumbani, kila mmoja wetu nchi yake. \q Adhabu yake ni kubwa kama anga. \q Inafika mpaka mawinguni."

vi.L: "Chúng ta đã muốn chữa cho Ba-by-lôn, nhưng nó không lành. \q Hãy bỏ nó, chúng ta hãy đi, mỗi người về xứ mình, \q vì sự phán xét nó đã thấu đến trời \q và dâng cao đến tận mây."
vi.B: "Chúng ta đã cố chữa cho Ba-by-lôn, nhưng nó không thể lành. \q Hãy bỏ nó; mỗi người chúng ta hãy về xứ mình, \q vì sự phán xét nó lên đến tận trời; \q nó dâng cao đến tận mây."
vi.R: "Chúng ta đã cố chữa cho Ba-by-lôn, nhưng nó không thể lành. \q Hãy bỏ nó mà về nhà, mỗi người chúng ta về xứ sở mình. \q Hình phạt của nó lớn như bầu trời. \q Nó cao đến tận các đám mây."

ko.L: "우리가 바빌론을 고치려 했으나, 그가 낫지 않았다. \q 그를 버려두고, 각자 자기 땅으로 가자. \q 그의 심판이 하늘에까지 닿았고, \q 구름에까지 치솟았기 때문이다."
ko.B: "우리가 바빌론을 고쳐 보려 했지만, 나을 수 없었다. \q 바빌론을 버려두고 우리 각자 자기 땅으로 돌아가자. \q 바빌론의 심판이 하늘에까지 닿고, \q 구름에까지 이르렀다."
ko.R: "우리는 바빌론을 낫게 하려고 했지만, 나을 수 없었다. \q 바빌론을 떠나서 모두 각자 자기 나라로 돌아가자. \q 바빌론이 받을 벌은 하늘만큼 크다. \q 그 벌이 구름에까지 닿는다."

pt.L: "Quisemos curar a Babilônia, mas ela não foi curada. \q Deixem-na, e vamos cada um para a sua terra, \q pois o juízo dela chegou até os céus \q e se elevou até as nuvens."
pt.B: "Tentamos curar a Babilônia, mas ela não pôde ser curada. \q Deixem-na; vamos embora, cada um para a sua terra, \q pois o juízo dela chega até os céus; \q sobe tão alto quanto as nuvens."
pt.R: "Tentamos fazer a Babilônia ficar boa, mas ela não pôde ser curada. \q Vamos deixá-la e voltar para casa, cada um para o seu país. \q O castigo dela é tão grande quanto o céu. \q Chega até as nuvens."

decisions.choice: we would have healed: we tried, but healing failed
decisions.reason: The verb describes an attempt that did not succeed. The speakers are those told in verse 8 to bring balm: probably foreigners living in Babylon, or her allies, who now give her up and go home. The written text and the text as read differ in the spelling of this verb, not in its sense.

decisions.choice: her judgment reaches to the heavens: her guilt and the sentence on it are beyond measure
decisions.reason: Judgment here is the sentence passed on Babylon, and the guilt that earned it. It reaches the sky because it is too great to be undone (compare Genesis 18:20-21; Ezra 9:6). Revelation 18:5 echoes the line.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks for the speakers of verse 9
decisions.reason: The poem quotes a group speaking in the first person, so the words take double quotation marks, as speech quoted inside an oracle does in Isaiah. Literal's "each to their own land" has "his" as the gender alternative, since men and women speak; Balanced and Readable say "each of us to our own", which needs none.

decisions.choice: « » for the speakers of verses 9-10
decisions.reason: The foreigners in Babylon speak here, so their words take quotation marks within the oracle.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks for the speakers of verses 9-10, as the English
decisions.reason: Within the oracle these are the words of others, so they are quoted. "kila mtu nchi yake" takes no gender span: the possessive has no gender.

decisions.choice: « » for the speakers of verses 9-10
decisions.reason: Speech quoted inside the oracle takes French quotation marks, where the English has double quotes.

decisions.choice: Double quotation marks for the speakers of verses 9 and 10
decisions.reason: As the English: speech of people inside the oracle takes quotation marks (terms note).

decisions.choice: cada um para a sua terra, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal puts "their / his" under the gender setting; Portuguese "cada um ... a sua" is already said of anyone, so there is no second wording.

source.text: הוֹצִ֥יא יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־צִדְקֹתֵ֑ינוּ בֹּ֚אוּ וּנְסַפְּרָ֣ה בְצִיּ֔וֹן אֶֽת־מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh has brought out our vindications; come and let us recount in Zion the work of Yahweh our God.

en.L: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has brought out our vindication; \q come, and let us tell in Zion \q the work of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God."
en.B: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has brought our vindication to light. \q Come, let us make known in Zion \q the work of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God."
en.R: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has shown that we were in the right. \q Come, let us tell the people in Zion \q what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God has done."

es.L: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha sacado a luz nuestra justicia; \q {{plural_you:vengan|venid}}, y contemos en Sion \q la obra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios».
es.B: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha sacado a la luz nuestra justicia. \q {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, anunciemos en Sion \q la obra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios».
es.R: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha mostrado que nosotros teníamos razón. \q {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, contemos a la gente de Sion \q lo que ha hecho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios».

fr.L: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait paraître notre justice ; \q venez, et racontons dans Sion \q l’œuvre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu. »
fr.B: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a mis au jour notre bon droit. \q Venez, faisons connaître dans Sion \q l’œuvre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu. »
fr.R: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a montré que nous avions raison. \q Venez, racontons aux gens de Sion \q ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu a fait. »

sw.L: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameitokeza haki yetu; \q njooni, tutangaze katika Sayuni \q kazi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu."
sw.B: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameidhihirisha haki yetu. \q Njooni, tujulishe katika Sayuni \q kazi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu."
sw.R: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameonyesha kwamba tulikuwa na haki. \q Njooni, tuwaambie watu wa Sayuni \q yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu amefanya."

vi.L: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm tỏ rõ sự công chính của chúng ta; \q hãy đến, chúng ta hãy thuật lại tại Si-ôn \q công việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta."
vi.B: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã minh oan cho chúng ta. \q Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy rao ra tại Si-ôn \q công việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta."
vi.R: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cho thấy chúng ta có lý. \q Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy kể cho dân ở Si-ôn nghe \q điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, đã làm."

ko.L: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리의 의로움을 드러내셨다. \q 오너라, 시온에서 \q 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 일을 이야기하자."
ko.B: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리가 옳다는 것을 밝히 드러내셨다. \q 자, 시온에서 \q 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 일을 알리자."
ko.R: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리가 옳았다는 것을 보여 주셨다. \q 자, 시온에 사는 사람들에게 \q 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 일을 이야기하자."

pt.L: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez aparecer a nossa justiça; \q venham, e anunciemos em Sião \q a obra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o nosso Deus."
pt.B: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} trouxe à luz a nossa justiça. \q Venham, vamos anunciar em Sião \q a obra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o nosso Deus."
pt.R: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} mostrou que nós estávamos certos. \q Venham, vamos contar ao povo de Sião \q o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, fez."

decisions.choice: our vindication: the LORD's acts that show his people to be in the right
decisions.reason: The word is the plural of *tsedaqah*, "righteousness". The plural names acts of righteousness, here the LORD's acts that put his people in the right against their oppressor, as a judge does when he decides a case for the one wronged (Micah 7:9; Psalm 37:6). It is not a claim that the people had no sin (verse 5).

decisions.choice: come, let us tell: a new group of speakers, the people of Zion in exile
decisions.reason: After the foreigners of verse 9, the exiles of Israel and Judah speak. They want to go home and tell in Zion what the LORD has done, as 50:28 says.

decisions.choice: a new quotation
decisions.reason: The words of the exiles take their own double quotation marks. Readable says what vindication means in plain words.

source.text: הָבֵ֣רוּ הַחִצִּים֮ מִלְא֣וּ הַשְּׁלָטִים֒ הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ר֨וּחַ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י כִּֽי־עַל־בָּבֶ֥ל מְזִמָּת֖וֹ לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֑הּ כִּֽי־נִקְמַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ הִ֔יא נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sharpen the arrows; fill the shields; Yahweh has stirred up [the] spirit of [the] kings of Media, for against Babylon his purpose [is] to destroy her; for [the] vengeance of Yahweh [is] it, [the] vengeance of his temple.

en.L: Sharpen the arrows; fill the quivers! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, \q for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} purpose concerning Babylon is to destroy her; \q for it is the vengeance of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q the vengeance for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple.
en.B: Sharpen the arrows! Fill the quivers! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has roused the spirit of the Median kings, \q because {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} plan is to destroy Babylon. \q This is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s vengeance, \q vengeance for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple.
en.R: Sharpen your arrows! Fill your bags with arrows! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has moved the kings of the Medes to attack, \q because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has decided to destroy Babylon. \q This is how {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will pay Babylon back, \q because she destroyed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Afilen|Afilad}} las flechas, {{plural_you:llenen|llenad}} las aljabas! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha despertado el espíritu de los reyes de los medos, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} designio contra Babilonia es destruirla; \q porque es la venganza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q la venganza por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Afilen|Afilad}} las flechas! ¡{{plural_you:Llenen|Llenad}} las aljabas! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha despertado el espíritu de los reyes de Media, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} plan es destruir a Babilonia. \q Esta es la venganza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q la venganza por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Afilen|Afilad}} {{plural_you:sus flechas|vuestras flechas}}! ¡{{plural_you:Llenen|Llenad}} de flechas {{plural_you:sus aljabas|vuestras aljabas}}! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha movido a los reyes de los medos para que ataquen, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha decidido destruir a Babilonia. \q Así le dará {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su merecido a Babilonia, \q porque ella destruyó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo.

fr.L: Aiguisez les flèches ; remplissez les carquois ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a réveillé l’esprit des rois des Mèdes, \q car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} dessein contre Babylone est de la détruire ; \q car c’est la vengeance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q la vengeance de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple.
fr.B: Aiguisez les flèches ! Remplissez les carquois ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a éveillé l’esprit des rois des Mèdes, \q parce que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plan est de détruire Babylone. \q C’est la vengeance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q la vengeance pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple.
fr.R: Aiguisez vos flèches ! Remplissez vos carquois ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a poussé les rois des Mèdes à attaquer, \q parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a décidé de détruire Babylone. \q C’est ainsi que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera payer Babylone, \q parce qu’elle a détruit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple.

sw.L: Noeni mishale; jazeni podo! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameiamsha roho ya wafalme wa Wamedi, \q kwa maana kusudi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} juu ya Babeli ni kuiangamiza; \q kwa maana ni kisasi cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kisasi kwa ajili ya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Noeni mishale! Jazeni podo! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameiamsha roho ya wafalme wa Umedi, \q kwa sababu mpango {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ni kuiangamiza Babeli. \q Hiki ni kisasi cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kisasi kwa ajili ya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Noeni mishale yenu! Jazeni mishale katika mifuko yenu! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaamsha wafalme wa Wamedi wakashambulie, \q kwa sababu ameamua kuiangamiza Babeli. \q Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakavyoilipiza Babeli, \q kwa sababu iliharibu hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

vi.L: Hãy mài sắc mũi tên; hãy đổ đầy ống tên! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã khơi dậy tâm thần các vua Mê-đi, \q vì ý định {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về Ba-by-lôn là hủy diệt nó; \q vì đó là sự báo thù của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q sự báo thù cho đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy mài sắc mũi tên! Hãy đổ đầy ống tên! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã khơi dậy tâm thần các vua Mê-đi, \q vì kế hoạch của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là hủy diệt Ba-by-lôn. \q Đây là sự báo thù của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q sự báo thù cho đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hãy mài sắc mũi tên! Hãy lấp đầy túi đựng tên! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thúc giục các vua Mê-đi tấn công, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã quyết định hủy diệt Ba-by-lôn. \q Đây là cách {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} báo trả Ba-by-lôn, \q vì nó đã phá hủy đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 화살을 날카롭게 하여라. 화살통을 채워라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 메대 왕들의 마음을 일으키셨다. \q 바빌론을 멸망시키는 것이 그분의 뜻이기 때문이다. \q 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 복수, \q 그분의 성전을 위한 복수다.
ko.B: 화살을 날카롭게 갈아라! 화살통을 가득 채워라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 메대 왕들의 마음을 움직이셨다. \q 바빌론을 멸망시키는 것이 그분의 계획이기 때문이다. \q 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 복수, \q 그분의 성전을 위한 복수다.
ko.R: 화살을 날카롭게 갈아라! 화살통을 화살로 가득 채워라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 메대 왕들의 마음을 움직여 공격하게 하셨다. \q 그분께서 바빌론을 멸망시키기로 정하셨기 때문이다. \q 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바빌론에게 갚으시는 일이다. \q 바빌론이 그분의 성전을 무너뜨렸기 때문이다.

pt.L: Afiem as flechas; encham as aljavas! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} despertou o espírito dos reis dos medos, \q pois o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} propósito contra a Babilônia é destruí-la; \q pois esta é a vingança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q a vingança pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo.
pt.B: Afiem as flechas! Encham as aljavas! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} despertou o espírito dos reis dos medos, \q porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} plano é destruir a Babilônia. \q Esta é a vingança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q a vingança pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo.
pt.R: Afiem as flechas! Encham as suas bolsas de flechas! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} levou os reis dos medos a atacar, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} decidiu destruir a Babilônia. \q É assim que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai fazer a Babilônia pagar, \q porque ela destruiu o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo.

decisions.choice: quivers: probably the cases that hold arrows; possibly shields
decisions.reason: The word is rare (2 Samuel 8:7; Ezekiel 27:11; Song 4:4). It is often taken as "shields", but "fill the shields" is a strange command, and beside "sharpen the arrows" it most likely means quivers, which are filled with arrows. If it means shields, the sense may be "take up the shields" or "fit the shields", that is, make ready for battle.

decisions.choice: the kings of the Medes: the rulers of Media and its allied peoples
decisions.reason: Media lay in the mountains east of Babylonia. Its kings had joined Babylon to destroy Assyria in the seventh century BC, but by the sixth century Media was part of the empire of Cyrus the Persian, and Medes were among the forces that took Babylon in 539 BC (Isaiah 13:17; Daniel 5:28-31). "Kings" may include the lesser kings under Media's rule (verse 28).

decisions.choice: the vengeance for his temple: for Babylon's burning of the temple in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Babylon burned the LORD's house in 587 BC (52:13). As in 50:28, the destruction of Babylon is the LORD's answer to that act.

decisions.choice: moved ... to attack; because she destroyed his temple
decisions.reason: Readable explains "stirred up the spirit" and says what the vengeance for the temple is for (m3). It says "bags with arrows" for quivers.

decisions.choice: los medos (L, R); Media (B)
decisions.reason: The Medes, as published 2 Kings 17:6.

decisions.choice: các vua Mê-đi
decisions.reason: The Medes are written as the published form of Acts 2:9 ("người Mê-đi").

decisions.choice: "화살통"; "메대 왕들"
decisions.reason: The English reads quivers (the meaning decision leaves "shields" possible); 메대 is the Protestant form for the Medes.

decisions.choice: os medos; a vingança pelo seu templo
decisions.reason: "Os medos" as Isaiah 13:17 has them in Portuguese; "a vingança pelo seu templo" keeps the words of 50:28.

source.text: אֶל־חוֹמֹ֨ת בָּבֶ֜ל שְׂאוּ־נֵ֗ס הַחֲזִ֨יקוּ֙ הַמִּשְׁמָ֔ר הָקִ֨ימוּ֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים הָכִ֖ינוּ הָאֹֽרְבִ֑ים כִּ֚י גַּם־זָמַ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה גַּם־עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Against [the] walls of Babylon lift up a signal flag; strengthen the watch; station watchmen; prepare the ambushes; for both has planned Yahweh, also he has done what he spoke concerning [the] inhabitants of Babylon.

en.L: Against the walls of Babylon raise a signal flag; \q strengthen the watch, station watchmen, \q prepare the ambushes! \q For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has both planned and done \q what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.
en.B: Raise a signal flag against the walls of Babylon! \q Strengthen the guard, post the watchmen, \q set the ambushes! \q For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has planned it, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done it: \q what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said against the people of Babylon.
en.R: Raise a signal flag to attack the walls of Babylon! \q Put more guards on watch. Post the watchmen. \q Get men ready to hide and attack by surprise! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has planned what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would do to the people of Babylon, \q and now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done it.

es.L: Contra los muros de Babilonia {{plural_you:alcen|alzad}} bandera; \q {{plural_you:refuercen|reforzad}} la guardia, {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} centinelas, \q {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} emboscadas. \q Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha planeado y también lo ha hecho, \q lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló contra los habitantes de Babilonia.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} una bandera contra los muros de Babilonia! \q {{plural_you:Refuercen|Reforzad}} la guardia, {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} centinelas, \q {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} las emboscadas. \q Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha planeado y lo ha hecho: \q lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo contra la gente de Babilonia.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} una bandera para atacar los muros de Babilonia! \q {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} más guardias. {{plural_you:Coloquen|Colocad}} a los centinelas. \q ¡{{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} hombres para que se escondan y ataquen por sorpresa! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} planeó lo que dijo que haría a la gente de Babilonia, \q y ahora lo ha hecho.

fr.L: Contre les murailles de Babylone levez un étendard ; \q renforcez la garde, postez des sentinelles, \q préparez les embuscades ! \q Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a à la fois projeté et fait \q ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit contre les habitants de Babylone.
fr.B: Levez un étendard contre les murailles de Babylone ! \q Renforcez la garde, postez les sentinelles, \q dressez les embuscades ! \q Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a projeté, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait : \q ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit contre les habitants de Babylone.
fr.R: Levez un drapeau pour attaquer les murailles de Babylone ! \q Mettez plus de gardes en faction. Postez les sentinelles. \q Préparez des hommes pour se cacher et attaquer par surprise ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait prévu ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ferait aux habitants de Babylone, \q et maintenant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait.

sw.L: Juu ya kuta za Babeli inueni bendera; \q imarisheni ulinzi, wekeni walinzi, \q andaeni waviziao! \q Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekusudia na pia ametenda \q aliyosema juu ya wakaaji wa Babeli.
sw.B: Inueni bendera dhidi ya kuta za Babeli! \q Imarisheni ulinzi, wekeni walinzi, \q tegeni waviziao! \q Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekusudia, naye ametenda \q yale aliyosema dhidi ya watu wa Babeli.
sw.R: Inueni bendera ya kushambulia kuta za Babeli! \q Ongezeni walinzi. Wekeni walinzi mahali pao. \q Andaeni watu wajifiche na kushambulia ghafula! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipanga yale aliyosema atawatendea watu wa Babeli, \q na sasa ameyatenda.

vi.L: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu nghịch cùng tường thành Ba-by-lôn; \q hãy tăng cường canh gác, đặt lính canh, \q chuẩn bị các toán phục kích! \q Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã vừa định vừa làm \q điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về dân cư Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu nghịch cùng tường thành Ba-by-lôn! \q Hãy tăng cường lính gác, đặt người canh, \q bố trí các toán phục kích! \q Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã định, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm: \q điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán nghịch cùng dân Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu để tấn công tường thành Ba-by-lôn! \q Hãy tăng thêm lính gác. Hãy đặt người canh. \q Hãy chuẩn bị người mai phục để đánh bất ngờ! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã định điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm cho dân Ba-by-lôn, \q và nay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 바빌론 성벽을 향하여 깃발을 올려라. \q 파수를 강화하고, 파수꾼들을 세우고, \q 복병을 준비하여라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바빌론 주민들에 관하여 \q 말씀하신 것을 계획하셨고 또 이루셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 바빌론 성벽을 향하여 신호 깃발을 올려라! \q 경계를 강화하고, 파수꾼들을 세우고, \q 매복을 준비하여라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 계획하셨고, 또 이루셨다. \q 바빌론 사람들에 관하여 말씀하신 것을 이루셨다.
ko.R: 바빌론 성벽을 공격하려고 깃발을 올려라! \q 보초를 더 세우고, 파수꾼들을 배치하여라. \q 숨어 있다가 갑자기 공격할 사람들을 준비시켜라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 바빌론 사람들에게 하겠다고 말씀하신 일을 계획하셨다. \q 그리고 이제 그 일을 이루셨다.

pt.L: Contra os muros da Babilônia levantem uma bandeira; \q reforcem a guarda, ponham sentinelas, \q preparem as emboscadas! \q Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tanto planejou como fez \q o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou contra os moradores da Babilônia.
pt.B: Levantem uma bandeira de sinal contra os muros da Babilônia! \q Reforcem a guarda, ponham as sentinelas, \q preparem as emboscadas! \q Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} planejou, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez \q o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse contra o povo da Babilônia.
pt.R: Levantem uma bandeira de sinal para atacar os muros da Babilônia! \q Ponham mais guardas de vigia. Coloquem as sentinelas. \q Preparem homens para se esconder e atacar de surpresa! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} planejou o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse que ia fazer com o povo da Babilônia, \q e agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez isso.

decisions.choice: raise ... strengthen ... prepare: orders to the attackers to set the siege
decisions.reason: The commands most likely speak to the armies coming against Babylon: raise the flag that calls the troops, keep a close watch around the city so no one escapes, and set men in hiding to catch any who try. They could also be mocking orders to Babylon's defenders, who will strengthen the watch in vain. Either way, the second half says the outcome is the LORD's.

decisions.choice: signal flag: a banner raised on a pole to gather troops
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah, the *nes* is a flag or banner raised on a height as a rallying sign (4:6; 50:2; 51:27).

decisions.choice: both planned and done: what the LORD intends, he carries out
decisions.reason: The two verbs together say that his purpose and his act are one (4:28; Lamentations 2:17). Babylon's fall is not chance but the fulfillment of his word.

decisions.choice: men ready to hide and attack by surprise
decisions.reason: Readable explains "ambushes" in plain words.

source.text: שֹׁכַנְתְּ֙ עַל־מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים רַבַּ֖ת אֽוֹצָרֹ֑ת בָּ֥א קִצֵּ֖ךְ אַמַּ֥ת בִּצְעֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: [You who] dwell on many waters, great of treasures, has come your end, [the] cubit of your cutting off.

en.L: You who dwell by many waters, \q rich in treasures, \q your end has come, the cubit of your cutting off.
en.B: You who live beside many waters, \q you with your wealth of treasures, \q your end has come; the thread of your life is measured to be cut.
en.R: You live beside many rivers and canals, \q and you have great treasures. \q But your end has come. Your life will be cut off like thread cut from a loom.

es.L: Tú que habitas junto a muchas aguas, \q rica en tesoros, \q ha llegado tu fin, la medida de tu corte.
es.B: Tú que vives junto a muchas aguas, \q tú que tienes tantos tesoros, \q ha llegado tu fin; el hilo de tu vida está medido para ser cortado.
es.R: Vives junto a muchos ríos y canales, \q y tienes grandes tesoros. \q Pero ha llegado tu fin. Tu vida será cortada como el hilo que se corta del telar.

fr.L: Toi qui habites près des grandes eaux, \q riche en trésors, \q ta fin est venue, la mesure de ton retranchement.
fr.B: Toi qui habites au bord des grandes eaux, \q toi qui regorges de trésors, \q ta fin est venue ; le fil de ta vie est mesuré pour être coupé.
fr.R: Tu habites au bord de nombreux fleuves et canaux, \q et tu possèdes de grands trésors. \q Mais ta fin est arrivée. Ta vie sera coupée comme le fil qu’on coupe sur un métier à tisser.

sw.L: Wewe ukaaye juu ya maji mengi, \q mwenye hazina nyingi, \q mwisho wako umefika, kipimo cha kukatiliwa kwako.
sw.B: Wewe unayeishi kando ya maji mengi, \q wewe mwenye wingi wa hazina, \q mwisho wako umefika; uzi wa maisha yako umepimwa ukatwe.
sw.R: Unaishi kando ya mito na mifereji mingi, \q nawe una hazina nyingi. \q Lakini mwisho wako umefika. Maisha yako yatakatwa kama uzi unaokatwa kutoka kwenye kitanda cha kufumia.

vi.L: Hỡi kẻ ở bên nhiều dòng nước, \q giàu có kho báu, \q sự cuối cùng của ngươi đã đến, là thước đo của sự cắt đứt ngươi.
vi.B: Hỡi kẻ ở bên nhiều dòng nước, \q kẻ có kho báu dồi dào, \q sự cuối cùng của ngươi đã đến; sợi chỉ đời ngươi đã được đo để cắt.
vi.R: Ngươi sống bên nhiều sông ngòi và kênh rạch, \q và ngươi có nhiều kho báu. \q Nhưng ngày tận cùng của ngươi đã đến. Đời ngươi sẽ bị cắt đứt như sợi chỉ bị cắt khỏi khung cửi.

ko.L: 많은 물가에 살며 \q 보물이 많은 자야, \q 너의 끝이 왔고, 네가 끊어질 [실의] 길이가 [찼다].
ko.B: 많은 물가에 살며 \q 보물이 넘쳐 나는 자야, \q 너의 끝이 왔다. 네 생명의 실을 잴 만큼 재었으니 이제 끊을 때다.
ko.R: 너는 많은 강과 운하 곁에 살고 \q 큰 보물을 가지고 있다. \q 그러나 너의 끝이 왔다. 베틀에서 실을 잘라 내듯이 네 생명이 끊어질 것이다.

pt.L: Tu que habitas junto a muitas águas, \q rica em tesouros, \q chegou o teu fim, o côvado do teu corte.
pt.B: Tu que moras junto a muitas águas, \q tu que tens tesouros em abundância, \q chegou o teu fim; o fio da tua vida foi medido para ser cortado.
pt.R: Moras junto a muitos rios e canais, \q e tens grandes tesouros. \q Mas chegou o teu fim. A tua vida vai ser cortada como o fio cortado do tear.

decisions.choice: many waters: the Euphrates and the canals of Babylon
decisions.reason: Babylon stood on the Euphrates, and a network of canals watered its fields and protected the city (Psalm 137:1). The waters that made it rich and safe could not save it (verse 36). Revelation 17:1 takes up the phrase.

decisions.choice: the cubit of your cutting off: the length of your thread has been measured, and it is cut
alternatives: the measure of your unjust gain is full
decisions.reason: A cubit was a measure of length, also used of cloth. The second word comes from a verb meaning to cut off, used of a weaver cutting the finished cloth from the loom (Isaiah 38:12). The sense is that Babylon's life has reached its measured length and is cut off. The same noun often means unjust gain, and the line could mean "the measure of your plunder is full", that is, the limit of your greed has been reached.

decisions.choice: you who dwell: an old spelling in the written text
decisions.reason: The written text spells the verb with an older ending; the text as read has the usual form. The meaning is the same (compare 22:23).

decisions.choice: the thread of your life is measured to be cut (Balanced); like thread cut from a loom (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "cubit". Balanced and Readable say what the picture means (m2); they use no measure, since "cubit" here is part of a figure of speech, not a measurement.

decisions.choice: la medida de tu corte
decisions.reason: "The cubit of your cutting off" pictures a weaver measuring the length of cloth before cutting it from the loom; Literal says "medida", and Balanced and Readable explain the picture.

decisions.choice: "네가 끊어질 [실의] 길이가 [찼다]" (L); "생명의 실을 잴 만큼 재었으니 이제 끊을 때다" (B); "베틀에서 실을 잘라 내듯이" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the length of the thread is measured and cut; Korean keeps the weaver's picture.

source.text: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־מִלֵּאתִ֤יךְ אָדָם֙ כַּיֶּ֔לֶק וְעָנ֥וּ עָלַ֖יִךְ הֵידָֽד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Has sworn Yahweh of hosts by his soul: surely I will fill you [with] men like locusts, and they will raise over you a shout.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts has sworn by {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}: \q Surely I will fill you with men like locusts, \q and they will raise over you a shout [of victory].
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has sworn by {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}: \q I will fill you with men, as many as locusts, \q and they will shout in triumph over you.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has made a promise and sworn by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own life: \q I will fill your streets with enemy soldiers, as many as locusts, \q and they will shout over you because they have won.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos ha jurado por {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} mismo: \q Ciertamente te llenaré de hombres como de langostas, \q y levantarán sobre ti grito [de victoria].
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha jurado por {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} mismo: \q Te llenaré de hombres, tantos como langostas, \q y gritarán victoriosos sobre ti.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha hecho una promesa y ha jurado por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia vida: \q Llenaré tus calles de soldados enemigos, tantos como langostas, \q y gritarán sobre ti porque han ganado.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées l’a juré par {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} : \q Oui, je te remplirai d’hommes comme de sauterelles, \q et ils pousseront contre toi un cri [de victoire].
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées l’a juré par {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} : \q Je te remplirai d’hommes aussi nombreux que les sauterelles, \q et ils pousseront contre toi des cris de triomphe.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a fait une promesse et l’a jurée sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre vie : \q Je remplirai tes rues de soldats ennemis, aussi nombreux que les sauterelles, \q et ils pousseront des cris contre toi parce qu’ils auront gagné.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ameapa kwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}: \q Hakika nitakujaza watu kama nzige, \q nao watapaza juu yako kelele [za ushindi].
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ameapa kwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}: \q Nitakujaza watu, wengi kama nzige, \q nao watapiga kelele za ushindi juu yako.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ametoa ahadi na kuapa kwa uhai {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe: \q Nitaijaza mitaa yako askari wa adui, wengi kama nzige, \q nao watapiga kelele juu yako kwa sababu wameshinda.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã chỉ chính mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà thề: \q Chắc chắn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngươi đầy người như cào cào, \q và chúng sẽ hò reo [chiến thắng] trên ngươi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã lấy chính mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà thề: \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngươi đầy người, đông như cào cào, \q và chúng sẽ hò reo đắc thắng trên ngươi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã hứa và lấy chính mạng sống {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà thề: \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho đường phố ngươi đầy quân thù, đông như cào cào, \q và chúng sẽ reo hò trên ngươi vì đã thắng trận.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신을 두고 맹세하셨다. \q 내가 반드시 메뚜기 떼 같은 사람들로 너를 채우리니, \q 그들이 너를 두고 [승리의] 함성을 지를 것이다.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신을 두고 맹세하셨다. \q 내가 메뚜기 떼처럼 많은 사람으로 너를 채우리니, \q 그들이 너를 이기고 환호할 것이다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신의 생명을 걸고 맹세하셨다. \q 나는 메뚜기 떼처럼 많은 적군으로 네 거리를 채우겠다. \q 그들은 너를 이기고 소리쳐 기뻐할 것이다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos jurou por si {{deity_pronoun:mesmo|Mesmo}}: \q Certamente te encherei de homens como gafanhotos, \q e eles levantarão sobre ti um grito [de vitória].
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos jurou por si {{deity_pronoun:mesmo|Mesmo}}: \q Eu te encherei de homens, tantos quanto os gafanhotos, \q e eles gritarão em triunfo sobre ti.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos fez uma promessa e jurou pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria vida: \q Vou encher as tuas ruas de soldados inimigos, tantos quanto os gafanhotos, \q e eles vão gritar sobre ti porque venceram.

decisions.choice: has sworn by himself: the strongest oath possible
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "by his soul", that is, by his own life. Since there is none greater, God swears by himself (22:5; 49:13; Genesis 22:16; Amos 6:8; Hebrews 6:13).

decisions.choice: surely: the form of an oath
decisions.reason: The words "for if" introduce the content of an oath and mean "surely" (Numbers 14:28).

decisions.choice: like locusts ... a shout: an army past counting, shouting over its prey
decisions.reason: Locust swarms stood for numbers beyond counting (46:23; Judges 6:5). The shout is the cry of grape treaders, here a victory shout (25:30; 48:33).

decisions.choice: [of victory] (L); in triumph (B); because they have won (R)
decisions.reason: The word names a loud rhythmic shout; in this setting it is a shout over the defeated, so Literal supplies "[of victory]" and Balanced and Readable say so.

source.text: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּכֹח֔וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּחָכְמָת֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנָת֖וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: [He is the] maker of [the] earth by his power, establisher of [the] world by his wisdom, and by his understanding he stretched out [the] heavens.

en.L: [He is] the maker of the earth by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power, \q who established the world by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stretched out the heavens.
en.B: It is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who made the earth by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power, \q who set the world firm by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding spread out the heavens.
en.R: God made the earth by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power. \q He set the world firmly in place by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom. \q He used {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding to spread out the sky.

es.L: [Él es] el que hizo la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, \q el que afirmó el mundo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría, \q y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} inteligencia extendió los cielos.
es.B: Es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quien hizo la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, \q quien afirmó el mundo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría, \q y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} inteligencia extendió los cielos.
es.R: Dios hizo la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder. \q Afirmó el mundo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría. \q Usó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} inteligencia para extender el cielo.

fr.L: [Il a] fait la terre par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, \q affermi le monde par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse, \q et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déployé les cieux.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a fait la terre par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, \q qui a établi le monde par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse, \q et qui, par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence, a déployé les cieux.
fr.R: Dieu a fait la terre par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance. \q Il a solidement établi le monde par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse. \q Il s’est servi de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence pour déployer le ciel.

sw.L: [Yeye ndiye] aliyeiumba dunia kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q aliyeuthibitisha ulimwengu kwa hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na kwa ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} alizitandaza mbingu.
